```verilog
module traffic_light (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input ped,
    output reg [1:0] light,
    output reg walk
);

reg [2:0] state;
reg [2:0] next_state;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        state <= 3'd0;
        light <= 2'b00;
        walk <= 1'b1;
    end else begin
        state <= next_state;
        if (state == 3'd0) begin
            light <= 2'b00;
            walk <= 1'b1;
        end else if (state == 3'd1) begin
            light <= 2'b01;
            walk <= 1'b0;
        end else if (state == 3'd2) begin
            light <= 2'b10;
            walk <= 1'b0;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        next_state <= 3'd0;
    end else begin
        if (state == 3'd0) begin
            if (ped) begin
                next_state <= 3'd2;
            end else begin
                next_state <= 3'd1;
            end
        end else if (state == 3'd1) begin
            next_state <= 3'd2;
        end else if (state == 3'd2) begin
            next_state <= 3'd0;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        walk <= 1'b1;
    end else begin
        if (state == 3'd0) begin
            walk <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            walk <= 1'b0;
        end
    end
end

endmodule
```

<details><summary>Example: compile: wrong port width (run s30-05_mac-A-r1-183133, round 0)</summary>

```verilog
module mac (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input clear,
    input en,
    input signed [7:0] a,
    input signed [8:0] b,  // Adjusted to 9 bits to handle signed multiplication
    output reg signed [19:0] acc
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        acc <= 20'd0;
    end else begin
        if (clear) begin
            acc <= 20'd0;
        end else if (en) begin
            acc <= acc + (a * b);
        end
    end
end

endmodule
```

<details><summary>Example: behaviour: `dout` wrong when wr_en (run s230-06_fifo-A-r1-182844, round 0)</summary>

```verilog
module fifo4 (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input wr_en,
    input rd_en,
    input [7:0] din,
    output reg [7:0] dout,
    output reg full,
    output reg empty,
    output reg [2:0] count
);

    reg [1:0] wr_ptr;
    reg [1:0] rd_ptr;
    reg [7:0] mem [0:3];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            wr_ptr <= 2'd0;
            rd_ptr <= 2'd0;
            count <= 3'd0;
            full <= 1'b0;
            empty <= 1'b1;
            dout <= 8'b0;
        end else begin
            if (wr_en && !full) begin
                mem[wr_ptr] <= din;
                wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1;
                count <= count + 1;
            end
            if (rd_en && !empty) begin
                dout <= mem[rd_ptr];
                rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1;
                count <= count - 1;
            end
            full <= (count == 3'd4);
            empty <= (count == 3'd0);
        end
    end

endmodule
```
</details>

<details><summary>Example: compile: syntax (missing ;) (run s232-06_fifo-B-r1-183657, round 3)</summary>

```verilog
module fifo4 (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input wr_en,
    input rd_en,
    input [7:0] din,
    output reg [7:0] dout,
    output reg full,
    output reg empty,
    output reg [2:0] count
);

    reg [1:0] head;
    reg [1:0] tail;
    reg [7:0] mem [0:3];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            head <= 2'd0;
            tail <= 2'd0;
            count <= 3'd0;
            full <= 1'b0;
            empty <= 1'b1;
            dout <= 8'd0;
        end else begin
            // Update full and empty first based on current count
            full <= (count == 3'd4);
            empty <= (count == 3'd0);

            // Determine if write and read operations happen
            reg write_happens = wr_en && !full;
            reg read_happens = rd_en && !empty;

            // Write operation
            if (write_happens) begin
                mem[head] <= din;
                head <= (head == 2'd3) ? 2'd0 : head + 1;
                count <= count + 1;
            end

            // Read operation
            if (read_happens) begin
                dout <= mem[tail];
                tail <= (tail == 2'd3) ? 2'd0 : tail + 1;
                count <= count - 1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
```
</details>
